planName.title: Planname
planName.description: The name of the current plan associated with your account

pricingRegime.description: The billing-resolved pricing regime for the account: 'overage' or 'topoff'

remainingCredits.title: Remainingcredits
remainingCredits.description: The number of remaining credits in your account under your current plan. Consuming these credits will result in no charge

overageCredits.title: Overagecredits
overageCredits.description: The number of overage credits in your account. These credits will be charged on your billing cycle.

renewalDate.title: Renewaldate
renewalDate.description: The date on which your current plan will renew

retentionDays.title: Retentiondays
retentionDays.description: The number of days that your data will be retained. If null, your data has unlimited retention.

storageRegion.title: Storageregion
storageRegion.description: The storage region used for new documents uploaded to the account.

overageEnabled.title: Overageenabled
overageEnabled.description: Whether or not overage billing is enabled for your account

inOverage.title: Inoverage
inOverage.description: Whether the account has consumed more than its plan allocation and is currently accruing overage charges

delinquent.title: Delinquent
delinquent.description: Whether the account's most recent Stripe charge failed and the subscription is past-due

upcomingInvoice.title: Upcominginvoice
upcomingInvoice.description: Details of the upcoming invoice, including the total amount and the date it will be charged

planCosts.title: Plancosts
planCosts.description: The cost per credit for your account, if applicable

billingMethod.description: The billing method for your account: 'free' (no billing), 'direct' (Stripe), or 'aws_marketplace'

awsContractDetails.title: Awscontractdetails
awsContractDetails.description: Details about AWS Marketplace contract, only present for AWS Marketplace subscribers

onpremCreditPool.title: Onpremcreditpool
onpremCreditPool.description: The single shared credit pool for an on-prem deployment. Only populated on on-prem deployments and only when the caller is a super admin.

featureFlags.title: Featureflags
featureFlags.description: Feature flags that apply to this workspace, resolved from the workspace owner rather than the calling member, so every member of a workspace gets the same experience.

entitledCredits.title: Entitledcredits
entitledCredits.description: the number of credits entitled per billing period

linkedAt.title: Linkedat
linkedAt.description: when the aws marketplace subscription was linked

AwsContractDetails.title: AwsContractDetails
AwsContractDetails.description: details about an aws marketplace subscription contract

totalCredits.title: Totalcredits
totalCredits.description: The contracted cap seeded at install time.

creditsRemaining.title: Creditsremaining
creditsRemaining.description: Credits still available before the deployment hits 402.

lastUpdatedAt.title: Lastupdatedat
lastUpdatedAt.description: Last time the credits doc was modified by a decrement or admin action.

OnPremCreditPool.title: OnPremCreditPool
OnPremCreditPool.description:
on-prem deployments share a single contracted credit pool seeded at install time.
every credit-consuming API call decrements creditsRemaining atomically. visible only
to super admins on /account.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the upcoming invoice. Currently this is always USD

amountRemaining.title: Amountremaining
amountRemaining.description: The amount remaining to be charged on the upcoming invoice

amountPaid.title: Amountpaid
amountPaid.description: The amount that has already been paid on the upcoming invoice

total.title: Total
total.description: The total amount that will be charged on the upcoming invoice

endDate.title: Enddate
endDate.description: The date on which the upcoming invoice will be charged

startDate.title: Startdate
startDate.description: The start date of the billing cycle for the upcoming invoice
